name: Soundboard
description: Big buttons that play tones, system sounds, speech, and audio from URLs.
code:
const pads = [
  { title: "Beep", color: "#FF3B30", play: () => audio.tone(880, 0.15) },
  { title: "Boop", color: "#FF9500", play: () => audio.tone(220, 0.25, { wave: "square" }) },
  { title: "Laser", color: "#34C759", play: () => { for (let f = 1500; f > 200; f -= 100) audio.tone(f, 0.02, { wave: "saw" }) } },
  { title: "Static", color: "#8E8E93", play: () => audio.tone(0, 0.4, { wave: "noise", volume: 0.3 }) },
  { title: "Ding", color: "#007AFF", play: () => playSound(1013) },
  { title: "Tock", color: "#5856D6", play: () => playSound(1104) },
  { title: "Hello", color: "#AF52DE", play: () => speak("Hello!") },
  { title: "URL clip", color: "#FF2D55", play: () => audio.play("https://www2.cs.uic.edu/~i101/SoundFiles/BabyElephantWalk60.wav", { wait: false }) },
]

ui.render(() =>
  ScrollView(
    Grid({ columns: 2, spacing: 12 },
      ForEach(pads, p =>
        Button(Text(p.title).font("title3", "bold").foregroundColor("white").frame({ maxWidth: Infinity, height: 110 }),
          () => { haptic("medium"); p.play() })
          .background(p.color).cornerRadius(20)
      )
    ).padding(),
    Button("Stop audio", () => audio.stop()).buttonStyle("bordered"),
  )
)

name: Web Tools Browser
description: Opens handy web tools inside AMod with a WebView.
code:
const tools = [
  ["Speed test", "https://fast.com"],
  ["Regex tester", "https://regex101.com"],
  ["JSON formatter", "https://jsonformatter.org"],
  ["Base64 converter", "https://www.base64-image.de"],
  ["Color picker", "https://htmlcolorcodes.com"],
]
const s = state({ url: tools[0][1] })

ui.render(() =>
  VStack({ spacing: 0 },
    Picker("Tool", tools.map(t => t[0]), tools.find(t => t[1] === s.url)[0], v => s.url = tools.find(t => t[0] === v)[1]).padding(),
    WebView(s.url),
  )
)

name: GUI Showcase
description: Every GUI feature in one script: tabs, cards, charts, pickers, menus and more.
code:
const s = state({ name: "", color: "#FF9500", date: new Date(), level: 0.6, on: true, choice: "B" })

ui.render(() =>
  TabView(
    Tab("Controls", "slider.horizontal.3",
      Form(
        Section("Inputs",
          TextField("Your name", s.name, v => s.name = v),
          Toggle("Enabled", s.on, v => s.on = v),
          Slider(s.level, v => s.level = v),
          Picker("Choice", ["A", "B", "C"], s.choice, v => s.choice = v).pickerStyle("segmented"),
          DatePicker("When", s.date, d => s.date = d),
          ColorPicker("Color", s.color, c => s.color = c),
        ),
        Section("Menu & disclosure",
          Menu("Actions", Button("Vibrate", () => vibrate()), Button("Beep", () => audio.tone(660, 0.1))),
          DisclosureGroup("More info", Text("Hidden until expanded")),
          NavigationLink("Open a page", Text("A pushed page!").font("largeTitle")),
        ),
      )
    ),
    Tab("Visuals", "paintpalette.fill",
      ScrollView({ spacing: 16 },
        Card(Text(`Hello ${s.name || "there"}`).font("title", "bold"), Badge("NEW", s.color)),
        HStack(Circle().fill(s.color), RoundedRectangle(16).fill("blue"), Capsule().fill("green")).frame({ height: 60 }),
        LinearGradient([s.color, "purple"], "diagonal").frame({ height: 100 }).cornerRadius(20),
        Gauge(s.level, { label: "Level", color: s.color }),
        Chart([{ x: "Mon", y: 3 }, { x: "Tue", y: 5 }, { x: "Wed", y: 2 }, { x: "Thu", y: 7 }]),
        Text("Glass card").padding().glass(),
        Emoji("🚀", 60).rotationEffect(-20),
      ).padding()
    ),
  )
)

name: Settings Hub
description: One-tap shortcuts to Settings pages and device controls.
code:
const pages = [
  ["Wi-Fi", "wifi", "wifi"], ["Bluetooth", "bluetooth", "antenna.radiowaves.left.and.right"],
  ["Cellular", "cellular", "cellularbars"], ["Hotspot", "hotspot", "personalhotspot"],
  ["Battery", "battery", "battery.100"], ["Display", "display", "sun.max.fill"],
  ["Sounds", "sounds", "speaker.wave.3.fill"], ["Focus", "focus", "moon.fill"],
  ["Privacy", "privacy", "hand.raised.fill"], ["General", "general", "gearshape.fill"],
]
const s = state({ b: device.brightness, v: device.volume, torch: flashlight.isOn })

ui.render(() =>
  List(
    Section("Controls",
      Toggle("Flashlight", s.torch, on => { s.torch = on; settings.flashlight(on) }),
      HStack(Image("sun.min"), Slider(s.b, x => { s.b = x; device.brightness = x }), Image("sun.max.fill")),
      HStack(Image("speaker.fill"), Slider(s.v, x => { s.v = x; device.volume = x }), Image("speaker.wave.3.fill")),
    ),
    Section("Open Settings", ForEach(pages, ([t, key, icon]) => Button(Label(t, icon), () => settings.open(key)))),
  )
)
